//go:build integration

package access_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"example.com/mutationfixture/contract"
	access "example.com/mutationfixture/providers/accounts.user/v1"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/plystra/data/database"
	"github.com/plystra/data/postgres"
	"github.com/plystra/kernel/configuration"
)

//go:embed schema.sql
var schema string

func TestGeneratedMutationProviderPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("PLYSTRA_RUN_POSTGRES_INTEGRATION") != "1" {
		t.Skip("requires disposable PostgreSQL")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	baseURL := os.Getenv("PLYSTRA_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if baseURL == "" {
		t.Fatal("PLYSTRA_TEST_DATABASE_URL required")
	}
	admin, err := pgx.Connect(ctx, baseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer admin.Close(context.Background())
	var random [8]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	name := "plystra_mutation_" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:])
	identifier := pgx.Identifier{name}.Sanitize()
	if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, "CREATE DATABASE "+identifier); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		cleanup, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if _, err := admin.Exec(cleanup, "DROP DATABASE "+identifier); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("test database cleanup: %v", err)
		}
	}()
	target, err := url.Parse(baseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid test database URL")
	}
	target.Path = "/" + name
	query := target.Query()
	query.Del("dbname")
	target.RawQuery = query.Encode()
	t.Setenv("PLYSTRA_MUTATION_DATABASE_URL", target.String())
	resolver, err := configuration.NewResolver(configuration.ResolverOptions{MaximumValueBytes: 4096})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reference, err := configuration.NewEnvironmentReference("PLYSTRA_MUTATION_DATABASE_URL")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	secret, err := resolver.Resolve(ctx, reference)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	backend, err := postgres.New(postgres.Config{URL: secret, MaxConnections: 2, HealthTimeout: 5 * time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := backend.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer backend.Stop(context.Background())
	if _, err := backend.Exec(ctx, database.Plan{Statements: []database.Statement{{ID: "schema", SQL: schema, Affected: database.AtLeastAffectedRows(0)}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	observer, err := pgx.Connect(ctx, target.String())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer observer.Close(context.Background())
	assertStored := func(text string, want int64) {
		t.Helper()
		var count int64
		if err := observer.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM accounts.users WHERE text=$1`, text).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != want {
			t.Fatalf("stored row count = %d, %v; want %d", count, err, want)
		}
	}
	provider, err := access.New(backend)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var resource contract.Resource = provider
	request := contract.Request{Key: 1, Text: "initial", Active: true, Token: []byte{}, Score: 1.5}
	row, err := resource.InsertOne(ctx, request)
	if err != nil || row.Key != 1 || row.Text != "initial" || !row.Active || row.Score != 1.5 || row.Token == nil || len(row.Token) != 0 || row.OptionalKey != nil || row.OptionalToken != nil {
		t.Fatalf("INSERT RETURNING codecs = %#v, %v", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.InsertOne(ctx, request); row.Key != 0 || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("duplicate insert lost conflict or exposed output", err)
	}
	if count, err := resource.InsertCount(ctx, request); err != nil || count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("DO NOTHING affected count", count, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.InsertOptional(ctx, request); err != nil || row != nil {
		t.Fatal("optional DO NOTHING", row, err)
	}
	if rows, err := resource.InsertMany(ctx, request); err != nil || len(rows) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("many DO NOTHING", rows, err)
	}
	request.Key = 2
	if count, err := resource.InsertCount(ctx, request); err != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("INSERT affected count", count, err)
	}
	request.Key = 3
	if rows, err := resource.InsertMany(ctx, request); err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Key != 3 {
		t.Fatal("INSERT many", rows, err)
	}
	request.Key = 4
	if row, err := resource.InsertOptional(ctx, request); err != nil || row == nil || row.Key != 4 {
		t.Fatal("INSERT optional", row, err)
	}
	request.Key, request.Text = 3, "updated"
	row, err = resource.UpdateOne(ctx, request)
	if err != nil || row.Key != 4 || row.Text != "updated" || row.OptionalKey == nil || *row.OptionalKey != 3 || row.OptionalText == nil || *row.OptionalText != "updated" || row.OptionalActive == nil || !*row.OptionalActive || row.OptionalScore == nil || *row.OptionalScore != 1.5 || row.OptionalToken == nil || *row.OptionalToken == nil || len(*row.OptionalToken) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("UPDATE RETURNING codecs = %#v, %v", row, err)
	}
	request.Key = 4
	if row, err := resource.UpdateOptional(ctx, request); err != nil || row != nil {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE optional empty", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.UpdateOne(ctx, request); row.Key != 0 || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE required empty", row, err)
	}
	request.Key = 2
	if row, err := resource.UpdateOptional(ctx, request); row != nil || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrBackend) {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE optional accepted two rows", row, err)
	}
	assertStored("initial", 3)
	request.Key = 0
	if rows, err := resource.UpdateMany(ctx, request); err != nil || len(rows) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE many", rows, err)
	}
	request.Text = "must-roll-back"
	if row, err := resource.UpdateOne(ctx, request); row.Key != 0 || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrBackend) {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE required accepted extra rows", row, err)
	}
	assertStored("must-roll-back", 0)
	assertStored("updated", 4)
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOne(ctx, contract.Filter{}); row.Key != 0 || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrBackend) {
		t.Fatal("DELETE required accepted extra rows", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOptional(ctx, contract.Filter{}); row != nil || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrBackend) {
		t.Fatal("DELETE optional accepted extra rows", row, err)
	}
	assertStored("updated", 4)
	request.Text = "counted"
	if count, err := resource.UpdateCount(ctx, request); err != nil || count != 4 {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE affected count", count, err)
	}
	request.Key = 99
	if count, err := resource.UpdateCount(ctx, request); err != nil || count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("UPDATE zero affected count", count, err)
	}
	canceled, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	stop()
	if count, err := resource.Clear(canceled, contract.Empty{}); count != 0 || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal("canceled mutation", count, err)
	}
	assertStored("counted", 4)
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOne(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 3}); err != nil || row.Key != 4 || row.Text != "counted" {
		t.Fatal("DELETE required", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOptional(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 2}); err != nil || row == nil || row.Key != 3 {
		t.Fatal("DELETE optional", row, err)
	}
	if rows, err := resource.DeleteMany(ctx, contract.Filter{}); err != nil || len(rows) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("DELETE many", rows, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOptional(ctx, contract.Filter{}); err != nil || row != nil {
		t.Fatal("DELETE optional empty", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := resource.DeleteOne(ctx, contract.Filter{}); row.Key != 0 || !errors.Is(err, database.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("DELETE required empty", row, err)
	}
	if count, err := resource.DeleteCount(ctx, contract.Filter{}); err != nil || count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("DELETE zero affected count", count, err)
	}
	for key := int64(1); key <= 2; key++ {
		request.Key = key
		if count, err := resource.InsertCount(ctx, request); err != nil || count != 1 {
			t.Fatal("reinsert", count, err)
		}
	}
	if count, err := resource.DeleteCount(ctx, contract.Filter{}); err != nil || count != 2 {
		t.Fatal("DELETE affected count", count, err)
	}
	if _, err := resource.InsertOne(ctx, request); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if count, err := resource.Clear(ctx, contract.Empty{}); err != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("parameter-free DELETE affected count", count, err)
	}
	assertStored("counted", 0)
}
